title: Find Minimum in Rotated Sorted Array
oneLinerQuestion: Find the minimum element in a sorted array that has been rotated.
explanation: Apply binary search: if mid element is greater than or equal to left element, pivot/minimum lies in right half; otherwise it lies in left half.
pseudoCode:
FUNCTION findMin(nums):
    l = 0, r = LENGTH(nums) - 1, res = nums[0]
    WHILE l <= r DO:
        IF nums[l] < nums[r] THEN res = MIN(res, nums[l]); BREAK
        m = (l + r) / 2
        res = MIN(res, nums[m])
        IF nums[m] >= nums[l] THEN l = m + 1
        ELSE r = m - 1
    END WHILE
    RETURN res
END FUNCTION
